page.title: Care pathway
page.intro: Organize your questions, explore education, and use the demo pathway to see how a counselling request might work in Rafeeq.
page.notReplacement: This page does not replace a qualified genetic counsellor. It explains possible next steps and shows prototype tools only.

nonDirective: Rafeeq does not make personal, marriage or reproductive decisions for you. Its purpose is to support understanding and help you access appropriate professional guidance.

journey.heading: An illustrative pathway
journey.caption: People move through these steps in different orders. Rafeeq does not tell you what to decide.

understand.heading: Understanding your information
understand.lead: Start with what screening can and cannot establish for you—not what someone else thinks you should do.
items: Carrier status describes a finding on a test; it is not automatically a diagnosis.
Couple-level meaning may require both partners' relevant findings and professional interpretation.
Reports use technical terms; glossary and Learn modules are general education.

learnNext.heading: Learning about next steps
learnNext.lead: Education can prepare you for conversations. It does not replace them.
items: Read about inheritance, uncertainty, and risk versus diagnosis at your own pace.
Use Ask for approved educational answers; hard questions belong with a person.
The public informed-choices guide lists pathways without ranking options.

professional.heading: Professional guidance
professional.lead: Qualified genetic counsellors and clinicians interpret findings in context.

prepare.heading: Preparing for a conversation
prepare.lead: Bring questions, your report, and what you hope to clarify—there is no single script.
items: What does this result mean for me and for a possible child?
What are the limits of this test?
What confirmatory steps might be discussed—and who decides if they are appropriate?
How can I share information safely with a partner or clinic?

services.heading: Finding appropriate services
services.lead: Availability varies by region and clinic. Rafeeq does not list real providers or live appointment slots.
items: Genetic counselling services may be available through hospitals, screening programmes, or referrals.
Specialised reproductive-genomics services exist in some settings when clinically appropriate.
Confirmatory testing is ordered by qualified professionals—not through this demo.

referralPreview.heading: Referral request preview
referralPreview.lead: Prepare what you might discuss with a counsellor. Use general topics only—do not enter real patient identifiers or full genetic reports here.
referralPreview.notSubmitted: Preview only – no referral has been submitted.

form.title: Draft your request
form.note: This form does not send data to a server.

placeholders.reason: e.g. Understand a carrier screening report (demo text only)
placeholders.topic: e.g. Autosomal recessive inheritance (not personal data)
placeholders.questions: List questions in your own words

consent.ack: I understand this preview does not share data and is not a referral.
consent.off: Clinic share is off in Privacy. A real referral would only include what you consented to share.

review.title: Review your preview
review.lead: Check your entries. Nothing is transmitted.

done.title: Preview summary
done.lead: This is how a referral payload might look in a future integration.
done.noBackend: No backend received this data. Reset to start again.

prototypeDemo.heading: Prototype pathway demo
prototypeDemo.lead: The MSW referral button below is a separate technical demo for counsellor queue testing. It is not the preview above and does not represent a real clinic referral.

when.heading: When a qualified counsellor may help
when.lead: A counsellor can sit with a result, a hard question, or a referral. This page is the path to that person.

result.title: After a result
result.body: A counsellor can explain what a result can and cannot say, including limits and next clinical steps.

question.title: When a question is hard
question.body: Ask routes questions that need a person to Care. Distress, diagnosis, and decisions belong with a counsellor.

share.title: When you choose to share
share.body: A referral can be sent only after clinic share is on. Privacy holds that switch.

empty: No pathway is available for this session.
error: The care pathway could not be loaded.

steps.confirmatory_assessment: Confirmatory assessment (if advised by a counsellor)

send.label: Counselling request
send.lead: MSW demo only: exercises the mock API for counsellor queue tests. Not a real referral.
send.action: Send my questions and what I understood to the counsellor
send.needsShare: This stays off until clinic share is on.
send.failed: The request could not be sent.

booking.label: Booking
booking.localOnly: Choosing a time stays on this device.
booking.demo: This calendar is a local demonstration. It does not book a clinic appointment.

next.heading: Next steps
next.lead: Ask can send a question. Privacy holds clinic share. Learn holds the education topics.
